# statuspage_component (Data Source)

Fetches a Statuspage component.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "statuspage_component" "example" {
  page_id = "abc123def456"
  id      = "xyz789"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Component identifier.
- `page_id` (String) Page identifier.

### Read-Only

- `automation_email` (String) Automation email address for the component.
- `description` (String) More detailed description for the component.
- `group_id` (String) Component group identifier.
- `name` (String) Display name for the component.
- `only_show_if_degraded` (Boolean) Requires a special feature flag to be enabled.
- `position` (Number) Order the component will appear on the page.
- `showcase` (Boolean) Should this component be showcased.
- `start_date` (String) The date this component started being used (YYYY-MM-DD).
- `status` (String) Status of the component.
